When the word denotes 'cause' it takes the 3rd case-affix.

Terms: विभक्ति-3

The affix णिच् is used after a root, when the operation of a causer is to be expressed.

Terms: णिच्

The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) is optionally used after those verbs which express the condition and its consequence.

Terms: लिङ्

The affix रूप्य denotes that which from something has originated when it is added to a word denoting 'cause' or to the name of a man viewed as a cause.

Terms: रूप्य

In connection with ह , the first finite verb retains its accent when an offence against custom is reprimanded.

Terms: Accent
